style.palette.summary: Theme colours match across the apps

ios.reason: iPhone rows sit on the lighter raised card, where the desktop hover colour was nearly invisible

failure.attach.summary: Attach warnings clear when an operation starts; failures append and successful files never clear warnings.

editor.empty.summary: An emptied edit shows the empty outline and a Move to Trash button, with no warning text; the button asks before trashing

editor.clear.summary: The editor's Clear empties the text and attachments without saving

editor.discard.summary: Leaving the editor with unsaved changes asks first, including navigation and pending imports; on iPhone, Item actions is a native sheet and Edit closes it and docks the editor in the Composer bar, where Feed taps ask before leaving and navigation waits for the editor to close

editor.paste.summary: Pasting a file into the editor attaches it

editor.save_restores.summary: Saving an edit of an Item trashed elsewhere brings it back

search.start.summary: Search always starts at All places, whichever place was open

search.topics.summary: Topics appear only at All places; dates and Has files leave them visible

editor.attachment_preview.summary: Capture and edit images page in the image viewer. Videos play like the Feed: iPhone viewer, desktop default app. Sent videos show Server frames; unsent iPhone videos show local frames. Viewers refuse drops; remove badges sit outside tile corners.

macos.reason: Unsent videos show a play icon until sent: no bundled video decoder, and WebView2 cannot read .mov.

windows.reason: Unsent videos show a play icon until sent: no bundled video decoder, and WebView2 cannot read .mov.

composer.attachment_order.summary: Attachments append in accepted input order

item.menu.summary: Available normal Item commands follow shared order; special conflict, rejected and Trash paths retain their policies

search.enter.summary: Entering Search protects changed Item edits before query or results mutation

search.activity.summary: Topic Search displays stored local activity on the right using Item result timestamp typography and formatting; name and count have no separators, and accessibility retains full Last active semantics

feed.attachment_pending.summary: An attachment not yet on the Server says so before it is opened; opening or copying one that is not on this Device does nothing instead of failing, and attachment errors clear after a few seconds

feed.opening.summary: Ordinary opening is bounded; older pages and explicit continuous reveal preserve history

composer.clear.summary: Clear draft is composer-wide, offered for pending-only drafts, and retires visible imports only after persistence; Undo restores completed content only

composer.pending_imports.summary: Count accepted operations including ordered publication waits; Clear retires only the originating generation, while physical work still gates restart and editor safety

ios.reason: The existing single-picker-batch API disables Attach while physically importing; desktop accepts overlapping operations.
